details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Out-of-bounds heap write in daemon argument parsing
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70456.patch: grow argv to argc + 1 entries in
       read_args() (io.c) before storing the trailing NULL, so a post-dot daemon
       request whose glob expansion lands argc exactly on maxargs no longer
       writes one pointer slot past the end of the argv allocation
     - CVE-2026-70456
